    Nonsplit extensions have smaller endomorphism rings #

    For a nonsplit short exact sequence 0 → L → M → N → 0, dim End M < dim End (L ⊕ N), stated as dim End M + 1 ≤ dim End L + dim End N + dim Hom(L, N) + dim Hom(N, L) (finrank_end_lt; ASS VIII.2.8). The proof uses the left exactness of Hom in both variables; the identity of L does not extend to M.
